title: Bibu's low shield
description: A simple resource pack that reduces the size of the shield for better gameplay visibility.
body:
![With vs without](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/14c5e33eb9986584a299e7a359d432fbfa865291_0.webp)**🛡️ Bibu's Low Shield**:

**Summary:** A simple resource pack that reduces the size of the shield for better gameplay visibility.

### **Why Bibu's Low Shield?**

Are you tired of your shield taking up half of your screen while exploring or fighting? **Bibu's Low Shield** is here to fix that! By reducing the shield's model size, this pack gives you back your screen space.

Whether you're exploring, mining, or defending yourself against mobs, you'll finally have a clear view of your surroundings! 👁️✨

### **📋 Key Features**:

![👁️ Improved Visibility: Significantly reduces the screen space occupied by the shield in first-person view.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4113881d0c905621a9d4f770d4fe4af765e12e05.png)
**👁️ Improved Visibility:** Significantly reduces the screen space occupied by the shield in first-person view.

**🎨 Vanilla Style:** Keeps the original texture and design, so it fits perfectly with your game.

**⚔️ Combat Ready:** Ideal for intense PvP or PvE situations where every inch of vision counts.

**🚀 Lightweight:** Zero performance impact, perfect for any setup.

### **Keep your eyes on the action, not on your shield!**
